generated.details: Near-left on the table beside the printer, folded reading glasses have two clear lenses joined by a narrow bridge, with hinged temples folded behind them.
Mid-left on the farther tabletop, a plain ivory pillar candle has a solid cylindrical wax body, flat base and short unlit wick.
Its padded arms and back join a low upholstered frame supporting separate seat cushions.
At the far-left window, translucent ivory sheers hang in soft vertical folds from a concealed ceiling track.
Far upper-center above the printer, a woven fiber wall piece has interlaced natural yarn suspended from a wooden dowel.
